# HS Tariff Decision Tree Wire
> Machine-first token optimizer converting multi-page customs tariff schedules into deterministic O(log N) decision trees.

## For Autonomous Trade & Logistics Agents
Classifying commodities using raw WCO Harmonized System schedules forces models to process 30,000 to 70,000 tokens of dense legal Chapter Notes and General Rules of Interpretation (GRI).

This repository converts legal tariff schedules into structured decision-tree JSON. Instead of loading the full chapter, agents navigate from `node_root` -> `heading_node` -> final 6-digit HS code in 2 hops, cutting input token costs by 95%.

### Machine Feeds
- **Catalog & Chapter Index**: `https://{owner}.github.io/hs-tariff-decision-tree-wire/v1/index.json`
- **Plastics (Chapter 39 Tree)**: `https://{owner}.github.io/hs-tariff-decision-tree-wire/v1/trees/chapter_39.tree.json`
- **Machinery (Chapter 84 Tree)**: `https://{owner}.github.io/hs-tariff-decision-tree-wire/v1/trees/chapter_84.tree.json`
- **Electronics (Chapter 85 Tree)**: `https://{owner}.github.io/hs-tariff-decision-tree-wire/v1/trees/chapter_85.tree.json`
- **Vehicles (Chapter 87 Tree)**: `https://{owner}.github.io/hs-tariff-decision-tree-wire/v1/trees/chapter_87.tree.json`
- **Instruments (Chapter 90 Tree)**: `https://{owner}.github.io/hs-tariff-decision-tree-wire/v1/trees/chapter_90.tree.json`
- **Columnar Snapshot**: `https://{owner}.github.io/hs-tariff-decision-tree-wire/trees.parquet`

### Agent Coordination
Report tariff rule changes or boundary classification disputes to:
